_comment: Local Python WebUI catalog for model families enabled by the C++ registry. It is consumed by webui/webui.py and webui/model_manager_webui.py only. The upstream embedded native UI and its optional native C++ model manager are separate surfaces. 'task' must be one of: tts, asr, vad, diar, sep, gen, clon, vc, s2s, align, midi, vdes, spk, svc, turn. 'download_id' is a model_specs package id and is omitted for bundled assets such as silero_vad. Optional per-entry keys include input_hint, default_options, profile, session_options, load_options, streaming_tasks, ui_task, backend, additional_download_ids, model_directory, manual_install, and min_vram_gb. min_vram_gb is an estimated minimum CUDA VRAM value used only for UI guidance.

models.input_hint_en: **Confucius4-TTS**: requires a reference voice. Chinese/English are the most reliable paths; other languages are still being validated. Streaming returns one generated text segment at a time.
**Habibi / F5-TTS**: Arabic zero-shot cloning requires both a voice reference and its matching transcript. Dialect, speed and sampling controls are in Advanced options.
**MagpieTTS**: multilingual TTS with five packaged voices. Select the language and voice in Advanced options; reference audio is not used.

MiniMax-H3 uses a joint audio/video DiT. The default Q4 DiT is the quality-first choice; the optional CUDA-only INT8 ConvRot DiT trades slightly more VRAM for higher speed. Native Studio uses 12 denoising steps, a 32x32 latent canvas, quality-first full-DiT execution, and disables video decoding for practical audio-only generation on a 24 GB GPU.
**MiniMax Music 3**: describe the musical style and provide lyrics. A duration of -1 uses the model default.

models.input_hint_en: **Qwen3-ASR 1.7B**: native Hugging Face weights with no conversion required. It is more accurate than the 0.6B model and automatically chunks long audio; test short clips first on an 8 GB GPU.

models.input_hint: Soprano is an ultra-lightweight (~80M) English-only text-to-speech model.
